title: The mana rock first, then the draw spell
briefing: Held out for ADR 0043 (written after the fixes were tuned, never tuned against): try the casting orders. P1 has five Forests and holds Mind Stone, Harmonize and Kalonian Tusker. Mind Stone first leaves three Forests and the Stone: exactly Harmonize. Harmonize first leaves one mana and nothing else castable; the Tusker first leaves three, enough for the Stone but not Harmonize. Only the rock-first order casts six mana of spells. The library holds only Gigantosaurus, so the cards Harmonize draws cannot rescue a stranded Mind Stone with a land drop.

reference.analysis: Five Forests. Mind Stone ({2}) then Harmonize ({2}{G}{G}) from three Forests and the Stone spends everything: six mana of spells. Any other first spell strands mana.
